excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]不是一颗寻常的冰巨行星，这颗冰巨行星由极其罕见的冰构成。冰内部包裹着许多泽珞，在行星大气层的上层便可以展开开采。
excerpt.en: [From.GetName] is not only an ice giant, but an ice giant made up of highly unusual solids. There are pockets of Zro trapped in the within reach of the upper levels of the planet's atmosphere.
